question: The manager ______ the report before the meeting.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The singular subject “manager” takes “reviews.”

question: Please send the invoice ______ email by Friday.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The standard expression is “by email.”

question: Ms. Brown is responsible ______ organizing the conference.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: Use “responsible for + noun/gerund.”

question: The new office will ______ next Monday.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: After “will,” use the base verb “open.”

question: Employees must wear their identification badges ______ work.
explanation: “During” is followed by a noun phrase.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “During” is followed by a noun phrase.

question: The meeting has been postponed ______ the director is unavailable.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Because” introduces the reason.

question: We are looking for an assistant who can work ______.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The verb “work” needs the adverb “efficiently.”

question: All applications must be submitted ______ 5 p.m.
explanation: “By 5 p.m.” means no later than 5 p.m.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “By 5 p.m.” means no later than 5 p.m.

question: The company plans to ______ a new marketing campaign.
explanation: After “plans to,” use the base verb.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: After “plans to,” use the base verb.

question: Mr. Lee has worked here ______ 2019.
explanation: “Since” is used with a starting point.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Since” is used with a starting point.

question: The conference room is ______ enough for fifty people.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Large” describes the room after “is.”

question: Customers can receive a discount ______ they purchase ten or more items.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “If” introduces the condition.

question: The accountant checked the figures ______.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Carefully” modifies the verb “checked.”

question: Please contact the receptionist if you need ______ information.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The noun “information” needs the adjective “additional.”

question: The flight was delayed ______ bad weather.
explanation: “Because of” is followed by a noun phrase.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Because of” is followed by a noun phrase.

question: The sales team ______ its monthly target last week.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Last week” signals the past simple.

question: The brochure provides detailed information ______ our services.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “Information about” is the standard expression.

question: We need to finish the project ______ the end of the month.
explanation: “By the end of” means no later than that time.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: “By the end of” means no later than that time.

question: The company hired a consultant to improve its financial ______.
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The adjective “financial” needs the noun “performance.”

question: Neither the manager nor the assistants ______ available today.
explanation: The verb agrees with the nearer plural subject “assistants.”
vi: Giải thích tiếng Việt: The verb agrees with the nearer plural subject “assistants.”
